description: Agent-ID normalization and git diff --numstat parsing are duplicated across multiple sandbox_executor modules.
goal: Consolidate agent-ID normalization into the canonical helper in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_defaults.py so apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/local_llm.py delegates to it instead of duplicating normalization logic, and extract a single canonical parse_numstat helper in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/git.py consumed by apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration_diff.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/review.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/delta_review_git.py. Keep every module within its existing line budget (do NOT increase or modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json). Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_dry_normalization_numstat.py verifying agent-ID normalization and numstat parsing edge cases, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Removing duplicate agent-ID normalizers and inline git diff --numstat parsers eliminates drift across runner and review stages.
acceptance_criteria: Single canonical helper exists for agent-ID normalization (agent_defaults.py consumed by local_llm.py) and git diff --numstat parsing (git.py consumed by calibration_diff.py, flow/stages/review.py, and flow/review/delta_review_git.py).
apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_dry_normalization_numstat.py verifies both helpers and passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
